integrity: The proof uses the published five-class classifications, the published translation-composition identity, and the published finite-frame maximal-world semantics of the nontrivial S4 operator. The two genuinely nontrivial products are reconstructed on arbitrary finite reflexive-transitive frames; all remaining table entries then follow formally. The primary full text and targeted literature searches were inspected for an explicit composition table or idempotent-monoid statement and none was located.
scientific_limitations: The classification is parameter-free and concerns normal additive modal-to-modal translations. It does not extend to the parameterized families. The finite-frame relation used in the proof is not asserted to represent the S4 operator on arbitrary infinite transitive frames.
title: A five-element idempotent translation monoid shared by \(\mathsf{S4}\) and \(\mathsf{Grz}\)
